Match the established reference visual identity: ivory-white / pale celadon, very restrained translucent organic glass surfaces, pine-green text, fine ink-wash tributaries with meaningful connection points, sparse warm amber for the selected focus. Make the middle reading area much quieter and higher contrast than the reference: opaque-enough milky surfaces for all text, landscapes remain faint around the margins and lower edge. Crisp large legible Simplified Chinese labels, elegant compact serif headings and clean sans-serif body, generous working space. No sidebar or vertical navigation rail, no dashboard grid, no duplicate chat transcript, no dense knowledge graph, no compulsory numbered workflow, no four-step success/progress bar, no claimed verification without evidence. Thin connecting streams indicate actual semantic relations, never arbitrary layout connections. Exactly ONE tiny abstract ink-brush bird beside the currently selected object; it is not a photorealistic pet and never steals attention. Controls look real and clickable. No cursor, no annotations, no watermarks, no invented additional copy. This is a fictional design scenario, not a live task-status screenshot.
Screen 01 of a connected interaction set: 工作总览态. Use the attached old work screenshot as visual reference ONLY; completely replace its content and composition with this new coherent work example. Do not retain the old sidebar-related topic or any four-step indicator.
Composition: stable task header at top, a spacious continuous work-scene canvas below. At left center are TWO small floating organic bubbles in an unboxed group titled '本次带入 · 2'. Bubble A: '允许只留下一点，不强制整理' with smaller '用于：保存入口与附言设计' and an inline affordance '查看这次怎样用 →'. Bubble B below: '保存材料，不等于恢复当时的触动' with smaller '用于：回看体验的判断'.
A clearly traceable fine green tributary runs specifically from Bubble A to a larger central-right selected island titled '这次怎样处理', showing the decisive readable sentence '附言作为可选项，不阻挡保存'. Beneath: '先完成保存，再允许补一句自己的感受。' A compact artifact-link row '保存交互原型 ↗', then the main pine-green button '查看实际影响 →'. Fine text beneath: '原型已实现；真实使用效果尚未确认'. This is evidence wording, NOT a progression bar.
Place the single tiny bird at the small amber connection between Bubble A and the selected decision island. Bubble B has a separate subtle branch ending at a small quiet note '仍需观察：几天后能否接回当时的想法', not a big empty task box.
Do not show a “工作中新增” card because the user has not left a discovery yet. No '等待带回' task pile.
Bottom center a compact, usable single-line capture input: '补一句现场发现，或带回一个结果……' with attachment icon and small green send arrow. Small secondary control '带回结果' near the input.
The screenshot should answer at a glance what work this is, which prior understandings participate, and where they affected one concrete decision. Keep overall calm, mature, product-like, and sufficiently distinct from a conventional three-column app.
